title: Cold glare
status: UNAPPROVED review v1; data-only candidate against approved27
intent: Both brows lower without added tilt while upper lids narrow into a still cold stare. A very small closed-contour purse suggests depressed corners without animated mouth acting during the hold.
scope: Existing symmetric vertical brow lowering, ordinary lid closure and small sealed purse only. No independent corner depression or brow flattening is available; original brow shape stays rigid with zero added rotation, and purse also narrows and lowers the whole closed contour. No new artwork, anatomy, runtime, shader, gaze or head/body movement.
timing_origin: New four-second interpretation: simultaneous measured onset .55, build .85, peak1.15-2.4, softened3.05, exact-neutral3.7-4.0. Compared with Sleepy Annoyance this has zero brow tilt, less lid closure, much less purse and no drowsy-first beat; compared with Silent Fury it narrows the lids and avoids inward brow rotation and lip compression.
